nativeComparisons.details: 14 formats x sizes 1x1/2x2/5x3/7x5/8x6/17x9 x forms perms, perms=ro, perms=rw, perms=toggle, perms=random:7, perms=mode=toggle:seed=0, alone and chained with hflip, negate (linear/graph/stream) or vflip (actor/timed), 3 frames of structured planes plus LCG noise. linear 7560 (rawvideo+framecrc, -ss/-t scopes), graph 3024 outputs from 1512 runs, stream 3024 + actor 1512 from 1512 runs, timed backend 3024 (rawvideo+framecrc, -ss 0.04 -frames:v 1). 504 checks that native perms output equals the input bytes. 16 refusals with native exit status asserted (EINVAL/ERANGE from os.constants.errno, 8 for option-not-found, 0 where native accepts), each refused on media and timed backends before any output (32). Per-source negotiation: 17 sources, 73 checks, all matched unchanged.

unsupported: mode=random without an explicit seed or with seed=-1 (native succeeds via av_get_random_seed; intentional refusal)
numeric or expression mode values such as mode=1 (native accepts)
non-canonical seeds such as 07 or 0x7 (native accepts)
generic timeline option enable= (native accepts: AVFILTER_FLAG_SUPPORT_TIMELINE_GENERIC)
runtime commands (native process_command for mode; refused with ENOSYS, enable with AVERROR_PATCHWELCOME)
frame writability itself (frames carry no permission flag)
hwaccel formats and formats outside the 14-entry negotiation table

notes: No shared edit beyond the two registry lines was needed.

Setup durations: Node 24.11.1 installed from nodejs.org tarball into the scratchpad (sandbox had Node 22.23.5; bootstrap requires 24+), ~10s; bootstrap --only npm,submodule,reference --allow-unpinned-reference 218s (npm 8s, submodule 7.7s, reference 202s); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+video-operator-registry 71s (all green, 8 registry tests).
Differential file: 90.5s on 4 vCPUs with --maxWorkers=1; unit file under 1s.
Sandbox reference binary differs from the linux-x64 pin (accepted by --allow-unpinned-reference); tests read build-metadata.json and assert commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm, and never pin a sha.
No float-sensitive or linux-gated cases: perms does no pixel arithmetic; negate's implicit conversions run with -cpuflags 0 natively and scalar arithmetic here.
Like copy, the descriptor is role identity with no formats(): native f_perms.c has no query_formats, and every source format negotiates unchanged (no storage-less picks).
